text_en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ , by the will of God , to all the saints who are at Ephesus and to the faithful in Christ Jesus .
text_la: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi per voluntatem Dei, omnibus sanctis qui sunt Ephesi, et fidelibus in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, pela vontade de Deus, aos santos que estão em Éfeso, e fiéis em Cristo Jesus:
text_el: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν[ἐν Ἐφέσῳ] καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: Grace be to you and peace, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
text_la: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
text_pt: A vós graça, e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai e do Senhor Jesus Cristo!
text_el: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who has blessed us with spiritual blessings in heavenly places, in Christ :
text_la: Benedictus Deus et Pater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, qui benedixit nos in omni benedictione spirituali in cælestibus in Christo,
text_pt: Bendito o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o qual nos abençoou com todas as bênçãos espirituais nos lugares celestiais em Cristo;
text_el: εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ,

text_en: As he chose us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and unspotted in his sight in charity .
text_la: sicut elegit nos in ipso ante mundi constitutionem, ut essemus sancti et immaculati in conspectu ejus in caritate.
text_pt: Como também nos elegeu nele antes da fundação do mundo, para que fôssemos santos e irrepreensíveis diante dele em amor;
text_el: καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ,

text_en: Who has predestinated us unto the adoption of children through Jesus Christ unto himself: according to the purpose of his will :
text_la: Qui prædestinavit nos in adoptionem filiorum per Jesum Christum in ipsum : secundum propositum voluntatis suæ,
text_pt: E nos predestinou para filhos de adoção por Jesus Cristo, para si mesmo, segundo o beneplácito de sua vontade,
text_el: προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς αὐτόν, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,

text_en: Unto the praise of the glory of his grace , in which he has graced us, in his beloved son .
text_la: in laudem gloriæ gratiæ suæ, in qua gratificavit nos in dilecto Filio suo.
text_pt: Para louvor da glória de sua graça, pela qual nos fez agradáveis a si no Amado,
text_el: εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ,

text_en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the remission of sins , according to the riches of his grace ,
text_la: In quo habemus redemptionem per sanguinem ejus, remissionem peccatorum secundum divitias gratiæ ejus,
text_pt: Em quem temos a redenção pelo seu sangue, a remissão das ofensas, segundo as riquezas da sua graça,
text_el: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων, κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ,

text_en: which has superabounded in us, in all wisdom and prudence ,
text_la: quæ superabundavit in nobis in omni sapientia et prudentia:
text_pt: Que ele fez abundar para conosco em toda a sabedoria e prudência;
text_el: ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει

text_en: that he might make known unto us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure, which he has purposed in him,
text_la: ut notum faceret nobis sacramentum voluntatis suæ, secundum beneplacitum ejus, quod proposuit in eo,
text_pt: Descobrindo-nos o mistério da sua vontade, segundo o seu beneplácito, que propusera em si mesmo,
text_el: γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: in the dispensation of the fullness of times, to re-establish all things in Christ , that are in heaven and on earth, in him.
text_la: in dispensatione plenitudinis temporum, instaurare omnia in Christo, quæ in cælis et quæ in terra sunt, in ipso;
text_pt: De tornar a congregar em Cristo todas as coisas, na dispensação da plenitude dos tempos, tanto as que estão nos céus como as que estão na terra;
text_el: εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν, ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς: ἐν αὐτῷ,

text_en: In whom we also are called by lot, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who works all things according to the counsel of his will .
text_la: in quo etiam et nos sorte vocati sumus prædestinati secundum propositum ejus qui operatur omnia secundum consilium voluntatis suæ:
text_pt: Nele, digo, em quem também fomos feitos herança, havendo sido predestinados, conforme o propósito daquele que faz todas as coisas, segundo o conselho da sua vontade;
text_el: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐνεργοῦντος κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,

text_en: That we may be unto the praise of his glory : we who before hoped in Christ :
text_la: ut simus in laudem gloriæ ejus nos, qui ante speravimus in Christo;
text_pt: Com o fim de sermos para louvor da sua glória, nós os que primeiro esperamos em Cristo;
text_el: εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ:

text_en: In whom you also, after you had heard the word of truth (the gospel of your salvation ), in whom also believing , you were signed with the holy Spirit of promise .
text_la: in quo et vos, cum audissetis verbum veritatis, Evangelium salutis vestræ, in quo et credentes signati estis Spiritu promissionis Sancto,
text_pt: Em quem também vós estais, depois que ouvistes a palavra da verdade, o evangelho da vossa salvação; e, tendo nele também crido, fostes selados com o Espírito Santo da promessa;
text_el: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν, ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ ἁγίῳ,

text_en: Who is the pledge of our inheritance, unto the redemption of acquisition, unto the praise of his glory .
text_la: qui est pignus hæreditatis nostræ, in redemptionem acquisitionis, in laudem gloriæ ipsius.
text_pt: O qual é o penhor da nossa herança, para redenção da possessão adquirida, para louvor da sua glória.
text_el: ὅ ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν, εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως, εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Wherefore, I also, hearing of your faith that is in the Lord Jesus and of your love towards all the saints ,
text_la: Propterea et ego audiens fidem vestram, quæ est in Domino Jesu, et dilectionem in omnes sanctos,
text_pt: Por isso, ouvindo eu também a fé que entre vós há no Senhor Jesus, e o vosso amor para com todos os santos,
text_el: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ, ἀκούσας τὴν καθ' ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους,

text_en: cease not to give thanks for you, making commemoration of you in my prayers ,
text_la: non cesso gratias agens pro vobis, memoriam vestri faciens in orationibus meis:
text_pt: Não cesso de dar graças a Deus por vós, lembrando-me de vós nas minhas orações:
text_el: οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου,

text_en: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of glory , may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and of revelation , in the knowledge of him:
text_la: ut Deus Domini nostri Jesu Christi, Pater gloriæ, det vobis spiritum sapientiæ et revelationis in agnitione ejus,
text_pt: Para que o Deus de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Pai da glória, vos dê em seu conhecimento o espírito de sabedoria e de revelação;
text_el: ἵνα ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ πατὴρ τῆς δόξης, δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ,

text_en: The eyes of your heart enlightened that you may know what the hope is of his calling and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints .
text_la: illuminatos oculos cordis vestri, ut sciatis quæ sit spes vocationis ejus, et quæ divitiæ gloriæ hæreditatis ejus in sanctis,
text_pt: Tendo iluminados os olhos do vosso entendimento, para que saibais qual seja a esperança da sua vocação, e quais as riquezas da glória da sua herança nos santos;
text_el: πεφωτισμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εἰδέναι ὑμᾶς τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς κλήσεως αὐτοῦ, τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις,

text_en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power towards us, who believe according to the operation of the might of his power,
text_la: et quæ sit supereminens magnitudo virtutis ejus in nos, qui credimus secundum operationem potentiæ virtutis ejus,
text_pt: E qual a sobreexcelente grandeza do seu poder sobre nós, os que cremos, segundo a operação da força do seu poder,
text_el: καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ κράτους τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ

text_en: which he wrought in Christ , raising him up from the dead and setting him on his right hand in the heavenly places .
text_la: quam operatus est in Christo, suscitans illum a mortuis, et constituens ad dexteram suam in cælestibus:
text_pt: Que manifestou em Cristo, ressuscitando-o dentre os mortos, e pondo-o à sua direita nos céus,
text_el: ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις

text_en: Above all principality and power and virtue and dominion and every name that is named , not only in this world, but also in that which is to come .
text_la: supra omnem principatum, et potestatem, et virtutem, et dominationem, et omne nomen, quod nominatur non solum in hoc sæculo, sed etiam in futuro.
text_pt: Acima de todo o principado, e poder, e potestade, e domínio, e de todo o nome que se nomeia, não só neste século, mas também no vindouro;
text_el: ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι:

text_en: And he has subjected all things under his feet and has made him head over all the church ,
text_la: Et omnia subjecit sub pedibus ejus: et ipsum dedit caput supra omnem ecclesiam,
text_pt: E sujeitou todas as coisas a seus pés, e sobre todas as coisas o constituiu como cabeça da igreja,
text_el: καὶ πάντα ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν κεφαλὴν ὑπὲρ πάντα τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ,

text_en: which is his body and the fullness of him who is filled all in all.
text_la: quæ est corpus ipsius, et plenitudo ejus, qui omnia in omnibus adimpletur.
text_pt: Que é o seu corpo, a plenitude daquele que cumpre tudo em todos.
text_el: ἥτις ἐστὶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ, τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν πληρουμένου.

text_en: And you, when you were dead in your offences and sins ,
text_la: Et vos, cum essetis mortui delictis et peccatis vestris,
text_pt: E vos vivificou, estando vós mortos em ofensas e pecados,
text_el: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν,

text_en: wherein in time past you walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of this air , of the spirit that now works on the children of unbelief:
text_la: in quibus aliquando ambulastis secundum sæculum mundi hujus, secundum principem potestatis aëris hujus, spiritus, qui nunc operatur in filios diffidentiæ,
text_pt: Em que noutro tempo andastes segundo o curso deste mundo, segundo o príncipe das potestades do ar, do espírito que agora opera nos filhos da desobediência;
text_el: ἐν αἷς ποτε περιεπατήσατε κατὰ τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου, κατὰ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ ἀέρος, τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ νῦν ἐνεργοῦντος ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀπειθείας:

text_en: In which also we all conversed in time past, in the desires of our flesh, fulfilling the will of the flesh and of our thoughts, and were by nature children of wrath , even as the rest:
text_la: in quibus et nos omnes aliquando conversati sumus in desideriis carnis nostræ, facientes voluntatem carnis et cogitationum, et eramus natura filii iræ, sicut et ceteri:
text_pt: Entre os quais todos nós também antes andávamos nos desejos da nossa carne, fazendo a vontade da carne e dos pensamentos; e éramos por natureza filhos da ira, como os outros também.
text_el: ἐν οἷς καὶ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἀνεστράφημέν ποτε ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν, ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ τῶν διανοιῶν, καὶ ἤμεθα τέκνα φύσει ὀργῆς ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί:

text_en: But God (who is rich in mercy) for his exceeding charity wherewith he loved us
text_la: Deus autem, qui dives est in misericordia, propter nimiam caritatem suam, qua dilexit nos,
text_pt: Mas Deus, que é riquíssimo em misericórdia, pelo seu muito amor com que nos amou,
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει, διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς,

text_en: even when we were dead in sins , has quickened us together in Christ (by whose grace you are saved )
text_la: et cum essemus mortui peccatis, convivificavit nos in Christo (cujus gratia estis salvati),
text_pt: Estando nós ainda mortos em nossas ofensas, nos vivificou juntamente com Cristo (pela graça sois salvos),
text_el: καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι

text_en: and has raised us up together and has made us sit together in the heavenly places, through Christ Jesus .
text_la: et conresuscitavit, et consedere fecit in cælestibus in Christo Jesu:
text_pt: E nos ressuscitou juntamente com ele e nos fez assentar nos lugares celestiais, em Cristo Jesus;
text_el: καὶ συνήγειρεν καὶ συνεκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: That he might show in the ages to come the abundant riches of his grace , in his bounty towards us in Christ Jesus .
text_la: ut ostenderet in sæculis supervenientibus abundantes divitias gratiæ suæ, in bonitate super nos in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: Para mostrar nos séculos vindouros as abundantes riquezas da sua graça pela sua benignidade para conosco em Cristo Jesus.
text_el: ἵνα ἐνδείξηται ἐν τοῖς αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις τὸ ὑπερβάλλον πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: For by grace you are saved through faith : and that not of yourselves, for it is the gift of God .
text_la: Gratia enim estis salvati per fidem, et hoc non ex vobis : Dei enim donum est:
text_pt: Porque pela graça sois salvos, por meio da fé; e isto não vem de vós, é dom de Deus.
text_el: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως: καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν, θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον:

text_en: Not of works, that no man may glory .
text_la: non ex operibus, ut ne quis glorietur.
text_pt: Não vem das obras, para que ninguém se glorie;
text_el: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων, ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται.

text_en: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus in good works , which God has prepared that we should walk in them.
text_la: Ipsius enim sumus factura, creati in Christo Jesu in operibus bonis, quæ præparavit Deus ut in illis ambulemus.
text_pt: Porque somos feitura sua, criados em Cristo Jesus para as boas obras, as quais Deus preparou para que andássemos nelas.
text_el: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα, κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς οἷς προητοίμασεν ὁ θεὸς ἵνα ἐν αὐτοῖς περιπατήσωμεν.

text_en: For which cause be mindful that you, being heretofore gentiles is the flesh, who are called uncircumcision by that which is called circumcision in the flesh, made by hands:
text_la: Propter quod memores estote quod aliquando vos gentes in carne, qui dicimini præputium ab ea quæ dicitur circumcisio in carne, manu facta:
text_pt: Portanto, lembrai-vos de que vós noutro tempo éreis gentios na carne, e chamados incircuncisão pelos que na carne se chamam circuncisão feita pela mão dos homens;
text_el: διὸ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ποτὲ ὑμεῖς τὰ ἔθνη ἐν σαρκί, οἱ λεγόμενοι ἀκροβυστία ὑπὸ τῆς λεγομένης περιτομῆς ἐν σαρκὶ χειροποιήτου,

text_en: That you were at that time without Christ , being aliens from the conversation of Israel and strangers to the testament, having no hope of the promise and without God in this world.
text_la: quia eratis illo in tempore sine Christo, alienati a conversatione Israël, et hospites testamentorum, promissionis spem non habentes, et sine Deo in hoc mundo.
text_pt: Que naquele tempo estáveis sem Cristo, separados da comunidade de Israel, e estranhos às alianças da promessa, não tendo esperança, e sem Deus no mundo.
text_el: ὅτι ἦτε τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ χωρὶς Χριστοῦ ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς πολιτείας τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ξένοι τῶν διαθηκῶν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ἐλπίδα μὴ ἔχοντες καὶ ἄθεοι ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ:

text_en: But now in Christ Jesus , you, who some time were afar off, are made near by the blood of Christ .
text_la: Nunc autem in Christo Jesu, vos, qui aliquando eratis longe, facti estis prope in sanguine Christi.
text_pt: Mas agora em Cristo Jesus, vós, que antes estáveis longe, já pelo sangue de Cristo chegastes perto.
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὑμεῖς οἵ ποτε ὄντες μακρὰν ἐγενήθητε ἐγγὺς ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: For he is our peace, who has made both one, and breaking down the middle wall of partition, the enmities in his flesh:
text_la: Ipse enim est pax nostra, qui fecit utraque unum, et medium parietem maceriæ solvens, inimicitias in carne sua,
text_pt: Porque ele é a nossa paz, o qual de ambos os povos fez um; e, derrubando a parede de separação que estava no meio,
text_el: αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν, ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἀμφότερα ἓν καὶ τὸ μεσότοιχον τοῦ φραγμοῦ λύσας, τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ αὐτοῦ,

text_en: Making void the law of commandments contained in decrees: that he might make the two in himself into one new man , making peace,
text_la: legem mandatorum decretis evacuans, ut duos condat in semetipso in unum novum hominem, faciens pacem:
text_pt: Na sua carne desfez a inimizade, isto é, a lei dos mandamentos, que consistia em ordenanças, para criar em si mesmo dos dois um novo homem, fazendo a paz,
text_el: τὸν νόμον τῶν ἐντολῶν ἐν δόγμασιν καταργήσας, ἵνα τοὺς δύο κτίσῃ ἐν αὐτῷ εἰς ἕνα καινὸν ἄνθρωπον ποιῶν εἰρήνην,

text_en: and might reconcile both to God in one body by the cross , killing the enmities in himself.
text_la: et reconciliet ambos in uno corpore, Deo per crucem, interficiens inimicitias in semetipso.
text_pt: E pela cruz reconciliar ambos com Deus em um corpo, matando com ela as inimizades.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκαταλλάξῃ τοὺς ἀμφοτέρους ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι τῷ θεῷ διὰ τοῦ σταυροῦ, ἀποκτείνας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And coming, he preached peace to you that were afar off: and peace to them that were near.
text_la: Et veniens evangelizavit pacem vobis, qui longe fuistis, et pacem iis, qui prope.
text_pt: E, vindo, ele evangelizou a paz, a vós que estáveis longe, e aos que estavam perto;
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐηγγελίσατο εἰρήνην ὑμῖν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ εἰρήνην τοῖς ἐγγύς,

text_en: For by him we have access both in one Spirit to the Father .
text_la: Quoniam per ipsum habemus accessum ambo in uno Spiritu ad Patrem.
text_pt: Porque por ele ambos temos acesso ao Pai em um mesmo Espírito.
text_el: ὅτι δι' αὐτοῦ ἔχομεν τὴν προσαγωγὴν οἱ ἀμφότεροι ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.

text_en: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners: but you are fellow citizens with the saints and the domestics of God ,
text_la: Ergo jam non estis hospites, et advenæ : sed estis cives sanctorum, et domestici Dei,
text_pt: Assim que já não sois estrangeiros, nem forasteiros, mas concidadãos dos santos, e da família de Deus;
text_el: ἄρα οὖν οὐκέτι ἐστὲ ξένοι καὶ πάροικοι, ἀλλὰ ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone :
text_la: superædificati super fundamentum apostolorum, et prophetarum, ipso summo angulari lapide Christo Jesu:
text_pt: Edificados sobre o fundamento dos apóstolos e dos profetas, de que Jesus Cristo é a principal pedra da esquina;
text_el: ἐποικοδομηθέντες ἐπὶ τῷ θεμελίῳ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προφητῶν, ὄντος ἀκρογωνιαίου αὐτοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: In whom all the building, being framed together, grows up into an holy temple in the Lord .
text_la: in quo omnis ædificatio constructa crescit in templum sanctum in Domino,
text_pt: No qual todo o edifício, bem ajustado, cresce para templo santo no Senhor.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ πᾶσα οἰκοδομὴ συναρμολογουμένη αὔξει εἰς ναὸν ἅγιον ἐν κυρίῳ,

text_en: In whom you also are built together into an habitation of God in the Spirit .
text_la: in quo et vos coædificamini in habitaculum Dei in Spiritu.
text_pt: No qual também vós juntamente sois edificados para morada de Deus em Espírito.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς συνοικοδομεῖσθε εἰς κατοικητήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πνεύματι.

text_en: For this cause, I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ , for you Gentiles :
text_la: Hujus rei gratia, ego Paulus vinctus Christi Jesu, pro vobis gentibus,
text_pt: Por esta causa eu, Paulo, sou o prisioneiro de Jesus Cristo por vós, os gentios;
text_el: Τούτου χάριν ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν-

text_en: If yet you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me towards you:
text_la: si tamen audistis dispensationem gratiæ Dei, quæ data est mihi in vobis:
text_pt: Se é que tendes ouvido a dispensação da graça de Deus, que para convosco me foi dada;
text_el: εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς,

text_en: How that, according to revelation , the mystery has been made known to me, as I have written above in a few words:
text_la: quoniam secundum revelationem notum mihi factum est sacramentum, sicut supra scripsi in brevi,
text_pt: Como me foi este mistério manifestado pela revelação, como antes um pouco vos escrevi;
text_el: ὅτι κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν ἐγνωρίσθη μοι τὸ μυστήριον, καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ,

text_en: As you reading, may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ ,
text_la: prout potestis legentes intelligere prudentiam meam in mysterio Christi:
text_pt: Por isso, quando ledes, podeis perceber a minha compreensão do mistério de Cristo,
text_el: πρὸς ὃ δύνασθε ἀναγινώσκοντες νοῆσαι τὴν σύνεσίν μου ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: which in other generations was not known to the sons of men , as it is now revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit :
text_la: quod aliis generationibus non est agnitum filiis hominum, sicuti nunc revelatum est sanctis apostolis ejus et prophetis in Spiritu,
text_pt: O qual noutros séculos não foi manifestado aos filhos dos homens, como agora tem sido revelado pelo Espírito aos seus santos apóstolos e profetas;
text_el: ὃ ἑτέραις γενεαῖς οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη τοῖς ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ προφήταις ἐν πνεύματι,

text_en: That the Gentiles should be fellow heirs and of the same body: and copartners of his promise in Christ Jesus , by the gospel
text_la: gentes esse cohæredes, et concorporales, et comparticipes promissionis ejus in Christo Jesu per Evangelium:
text_pt: A saber, que os gentios são co-herdeiros, e de um mesmo corpo, e participantes da promessa em Cristo pelo evangelho;
text_el: εἶναι τὰ ἔθνη συγκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

text_en: of which I am made a minister , according to the gift of the grace of God , which is given to me according to the operation of his power.
text_la: cujus factus sum minister secundum donum gratiæ Dei, quæ data est mihi secundum operationem virtutis ejus.
text_pt: Do qual fui feito ministro, pelo dom da graça de Deus, que me foi dado segundo a operação do seu poder.
text_el: οὗ ἐγενήθην διάκονος κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ.

text_en: To me, the least of all the saints , is given this grace , to preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ :
text_la: Mihi omnium sanctorum minimo data est gratia hæc, in gentibus evangelizare investigabiles divitias Christi,
text_pt: A mim, o mínimo de todos os santos, me foi dada esta graça de anunciar entre os gentios, por meio do evangelho, as riquezas incompreensíveis de Cristo,
text_el: ἐμοὶ τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις αὕτη, τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαι τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: And to enlighten all men , that they may see what is the dispensation of the mystery which has been hidden from eternity in God who created all things:
text_la: et illuminare omnes, quæ sit dispensatio sacramenti absconditi a sæculis in Deo, qui omnia creavit:
text_pt: E demonstrar a todos qual seja a comunhão do mistério, que desde os séculos esteve oculto em Deus, que tudo criou por meio de Jesus Cristo;
text_el: καὶ φωτίσαι τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἐν τῷ θεῷ τῷ τὰ πάντα κτίσαντι,

text_en: That the manifold wisdom of God may be made known to the principalities and powers in heavenly places through the church,
text_la: ut innotescat principatibus et potestatibus in cælestibus per Ecclesiam, multiformis sapientia Dei,
text_pt: Para que agora, pela igreja, a multiforme sabedoria de Deus seja conhecida dos principados e potestades nos céus,
text_el: ἵνα γνωρισθῇ νῦν ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: according to the eternal purpose which he made in Christ Jesus our Lord :
text_la: secundum præfinitionem sæculorum, quam fecit in Christo Jesu Domino nostro:
text_pt: Segundo o eterno propósito que fez em Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor,
text_el: κατὰ πρόθεσιν τῶν αἰώνων ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν,

text_en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
text_la: in quo habemus fiduciam, et accessum in confidentia per fidem ejus.
text_pt: No qual temos ousadia e acesso com confiança, pela nossa fé nele.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν πεποιθήσει διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Wherefore I pray you not to faint at my tribulations for you, which is your glory .
text_la: Propter quod peto ne deficiatis in tribulationibus meis pro vobis : quæ est gloria vestra.
text_pt: Portanto, vos peço que não desfaleçais nas minhas tribulações por vós, que são a vossa glória.
text_el: Διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ἐγκακεῖν ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσίν μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἐστὶν δόξα ὑμῶν.

text_en: For this cause I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
text_la: Hujus rei gratia flecto genua mea ad Patrem Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
text_pt: Por causa disto me ponho de joelhos perante o Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
text_el: τούτου χάριν κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα,

text_en: of whom all paternity in heaven and earth is named :
text_la: ex quo omnis paternitas in cælis et in terra nominatur,
text_pt: Do qual toda a família nos céus e na terra toma o nome,
text_el: ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται,

text_en: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory , to be strengthened by his Spirit with might unto the inward man :
text_la: ut det vobis secundum divitias gloriæ suæ, virtute corroborari per Spiritum ejus in interiorem hominem,
text_pt: Para que, segundo as riquezas da sua glória, vos conceda que sejais corroborados com poder pelo seu Espírito no homem interior;
text_el: ἵνα δῷ ὑμῖν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ δυνάμει κραταιωθῆναι διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον,

text_en: That Christ may dwell by faith in your hearts: that, being rooted and founded in charity ,
text_la: Christum habitare per fidem in cordibus vestris : in caritate radicati, et fundati,
text_pt: Para que Cristo habite pela fé nos vossos corações; a fim de, estando arraigados e fundados em amor,
text_el: κατοικῆσαι τὸν Χριστὸν διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν, ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι,

text_en: you may be able to comprehend, with all the saints , what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
text_la: ut possitis comprehendere cum omnibus sanctis, quæ sit latitudo, et longitudo, et sublimitas, et profundum:
text_pt: Poderdes perfeitamente compreender, com todos os santos, qual seja a largura, e o comprimento, e a altura, e a profundidade,
text_el: ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ὕψος καὶ βάθος,

text_en: to know also the charity of Christ , which surpasses all knowledge : that you may be filled unto all the fullness of God .
text_la: scire etiam supereminentem scientiæ caritatem Christi, ut impleamini in omnem plenitudinem Dei.
text_pt: E conhecer o amor de Cristo, que excede todo o entendimento, para que sejais cheios de toda a plenitude de Deus.
text_el: γνῶναί τε τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Now to him who is able to do all things more abundantly than we desire or understand, according to the power that works in us:
text_la: Ei autem, qui potens est omnia facere superabundanter quam petimus aut intelligimus, secundum virtutem, quæ operatur in nobis:
text_pt: Ora, àquele que é poderoso para fazer tudo muito mais abundantemente além daquilo que pedimos ou pensamos, segundo o poder que em nós opera,
text_el: τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν,

text_en: To him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus , unto all generations , world without end. Amen .
text_la: ipsi gloria in Ecclesia, et in Christo Jesu, in omnes generationes sæculi sæculorum. Amen.
text_pt: A esse glória na igreja, por Jesus Cristo, em todas as gerações, para todo o sempre. Amém.
text_el: αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων: ἀμήν.

text_en: I therefore, a prisoner in the Lord , beseech you that you walk worthy of the vocation in which you are called:
text_la: Obsecro itaque vos ego vinctus in Domino, ut digne ambuletis vocatione, qua vocati estis,
text_pt: Rogo-vos, pois, eu, o preso do Senhor, que andeis como é digno da vocação com que fostes chamados,
text_el: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ ὁ δέσμιος ἐν κυρίῳ ἀξίως περιπατῆσαι τῆς κλήσεως ἧς ἐκλήθητε,

text_en: With all humility and mildness, with patience, supporting one another in charity .
text_la: cum omni humilitate, et mansuetudine, cum patientia, supportantes invicem in caritate,
text_pt: Com toda a humildade e mansidão, com longanimidade, suportando-vos uns aos outros em amor,
text_el: μετὰ πάσης ταπεινοφροσύνης καὶ πραΰτητος, μετὰ μακροθυμίας, ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων ἐν ἀγάπῃ,

text_en: Careful to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
text_la: solliciti servare unitatem Spiritus in vinculo pacis.
text_pt: Procurando guardar a unidade do Espírito pelo vínculo da paz.
text_el: σπουδάζοντες τηρεῖν τὴν ἑνότητα τοῦ πνεύματος ἐν τῷ συνδέσμῳ τῆς εἰρήνης:

text_en: One body and one Spirit : as you are called in one hope of your calling.
text_la: Unum corpus, et unus Spiritus, sicut vocati estis in una spe vocationis vestræ.
text_pt: Há um só corpo e um só Espírito, como também fostes chamados em uma só esperança da vossa vocação;
text_el: ἓν σῶμα καὶ ἓν πνεῦμα, καθὼς [καὶ] ἐκλήθητε ἐν μιᾷ ἐλπίδι τῆς κλήσεως ὑμῶν:

text_en: One Lord , one faith , one baptism .
text_la: Unus Dominus, una fides, unum baptisma.
text_pt: Um só Senhor, uma só fé, um só batismo;
text_el: εἷς κύριος, μία πίστις, ἓν βάπτισμα:

text_en: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in us all.
text_la: Unus Deus et Pater omnium, qui est super omnes, et per omnia, et in omnibus nobis.
text_pt: Um só Deus e Pai de todos, o qual é sobre todos, e por todos e em todos vós.
text_el: εἷς θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ πάντων, ὁ ἐπὶ πάντων καὶ διὰ πάντων καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν.

text_en: But to every one of us is given grace , according to the measure of the giving of Christ .
text_la: Unicuique autem nostrum data est gratia secundum mensuram donationis Christi.
text_pt: Mas a graça foi dada a cada um de nós segundo a medida do dom de Cristo.
text_el: ἑνὶ δὲ ἑκάστῳ ἡμῶν ἐδόθη [ἡ] χάρις κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τῆς δωρεᾶς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: Wherefore he says: Ascending on high, he led captivity captive: he gave gifts to men .
text_la: Propter quod dicit : Ascendens in altum, captivam duxit captivitatem : dedit dona hominibus.
text_pt: Por isso diz:Subindo ao alto, levou cativo o cativeiro,e deu dons aos homens.
text_el: διὸ λέγει, ἀναβὰς εἰς ὕψος ᾐχμαλώτευσεν αἰχμαλωσίαν, [καὶ] ἔδωκεν δόματα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.

text_en: Now that he ascended , what is it, but because he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
text_la: Quod autem ascendit, quid est, nisi quia et descendit primum in inferiores partes terræ?
text_pt: Ora, istoele subiuque é, senão que também antes tinha descido às partes mais baixas da terra?
text_el: τὸ δὲ ἀνέβη τί ἐστιν εἰ μὴ ὅτι καὶ κατέβη εἰς τὰ κατώτερα μέρη] τῆς γῆς;

text_en: He that descended is the same also that ascended above all the heavens : that he might fill all things.
text_la: Qui descendit, ipse est et qui ascendit super omnes cælos, ut impleret omnia.
text_pt: Aquele que desceu é também o mesmo que subiu acima de todos os céus, para cumprir todas as coisas.
text_el: ὁ καταβὰς αὐτός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ ἀναβὰς ὑπεράνω πάντων τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἵνα πληρώσῃ τὰ πάντα.

text_en: And he gave some apostles , and some prophets , and other some evangelists , and other some pastors and doctors :
text_la: Et ipse dedit quosdam quidem apostolos, quosdam autem prophetas, alios vero evangelistas, alios autem pastores et doctores,
text_pt: E ele mesmo deu uns para apóstolos, e outros para profetas, e outros para evangelistas, e outros para pastores e doutores,
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἔδωκεν τοὺς μὲν ἀποστόλους, τοὺς δὲ προφήτας, τοὺς δὲ εὐαγγελιστάς, τοὺς δὲ ποιμένας καὶ διδασκάλους,

text_en: For the perfecting of the saints , for the word of the ministry , for the edifying of the body of Christ :
text_la: ad consummationem sanctorum in opus ministerii, in ædificationem corporis Christi:
text_pt: Querendo o aperfeiçoamento dos santos, para a obra do ministério, para edificação do corpo de Cristo;
text_el: πρὸς τὸν καταρτισμὸν τῶν ἁγίων εἰς ἔργον διακονίας, εἰς οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: Until we all meet into the unity of faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the age of the fullness of Christ :
text_la: donec occurramus omnes in unitatem fidei, et agnitionis Filii Dei, in virum perfectum, in mensuram ætatis plenitudinis Christi:
text_pt: Até que todos cheguemos à unidade da fé, e ao conhecimento do Filho de Deus, a homem perfeito, à medida da estatura completa de Cristo,
text_el: μέχρι καταντήσωμεν οἱ πάντες εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς ἄνδρα τέλειον, εἰς μέτρον ἡλικίας τοῦ πληρώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: That henceforth we be no more children tossed to and fro and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the wickedness of men , by cunning craftiness by which they lie in wait to deceive.
text_la: ut jam non simus parvuli fluctuantes, et circumferamur omni vento doctrinæ in nequitia hominum, in astutia ad circumventionem erroris.
text_pt: Para que não sejamos mais meninos inconstantes, levados em roda por todo o vento de doutrina, pelo engano dos homens que com astúcia enganam fraudulosamente.
text_el: ἵνα μηκέτι ὦμεν νήπιοι, κλυδωνιζόμενοι καὶ περιφερόμενοι παντὶ ἀνέμῳ τῆς διδασκαλίας ἐν τῇ κυβείᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν πανουργίᾳ πρὸς τὴν μεθοδείαν τῆς πλάνης

text_en: But doing the truth in charity , we may in all things grow up in him who is the head, even Christ :
text_la: Veritatem autem facientes in caritate, crescamus in illo per omnia, qui est caput Christus:
text_pt: Antes, seguindo a verdade em amor, cresçamos em tudo naquele que é a cabeça, Cristo,
text_el: ἀληθεύοντες δὲ ἐν ἀγάπῃ αὐξήσωμεν εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλή, Χριστός,

text_en: From whom the whole body, being compacted and fitly joined together, by what every joint supplies, according to the operation in the measure of every part, makes increase of the body, unto the edifying of itself in charity .
text_la: ex quo totum corpus compactum et connexum per omnem juncturam subministrationis, secundum operationem in mensuram uniuscujusque membri, augmentum corporis facit in ædificationem sui in caritate.
text_pt: Do qual todo o corpo, bem ajustado, e ligado pelo auxílio de todas as juntas, segundo a justa operação de cada parte, faz o aumento do corpo, para sua edificação em amor.
text_el: ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα συναρμολογούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον διὰ πάσης ἁφῆς τῆς ἐπιχορηγίας κατ' ἐνέργειαν ἐν μέτρῳ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου μέρους τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ σώματος ποιεῖται εἰς οἰκοδομὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ.

text_en: This then I say and testify in the Lord : That henceforward you walk not as also the Gentiles walk in the vanity of their mind :
text_la: Hoc igitur dico, et testificor in Domino, ut jam non ambuletis, sicut et gentes ambulant in vanitate sensus sui,
text_pt: E digo isto, e testifico no Senhor, para que não andeis mais como andam também os outros gentios, na vaidade da sua mente.
text_el: Τοῦτο οὖν λέγω καὶ μαρτύρομαι ἐν κυρίῳ, μηκέτι ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καθὼς καὶ τὰ ἔθνη περιπατεῖ ἐν ματαιότητι τοῦ νοὸς αὐτῶν,

text_en: Having their understanding darkened: being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their hearts.
text_la: tenebris obscuratum habentes intellectum, alienati a vita Dei per ignorantiam, quæ est in illis, propter cæcitatem cordis ipsorum,
text_pt: Entenebrecidos no entendimento, separados da vida de Deus pela ignorância que há neles, pela dureza do seu coração;
text_el: ἐσκοτωμένοι τῇ διανοίᾳ ὄντες, ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ θεοῦ, διὰ τὴν ἄγνοιαν τὴν οὖσαν ἐν αὐτοῖς, διὰ τὴν πώρωσιν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν,

text_en: Who despairing have given themselves up to lasciviousness, unto the working of all uncleanness , unto covetousness .
text_la: qui desperantes, semetipsos tradiderunt impudicitiæ, in operationem immunditiæ omnis in avaritiam.
text_pt: Os quais, havendo perdido todo o sentimento, se entregaram à dissolução, para com avidez cometerem toda a impureza.
text_el: οἵτινες ἀπηλγηκότες ἑαυτοὺς παρέδωκαν τῇ ἀσελγείᾳ εἰς ἐργασίαν ἀκαθαρσίας πάσης ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ.

text_en: But you have not so learned Christ :
text_la: Vos autem non ita didicistis Christum,
text_pt: Mas vós não aprendestes assim a Cristo,
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως ἐμάθετε τὸν Χριστόν,

text_en: If so be that you have heard him and have been taught in him, as the truth is in Jesus :
text_la: si tamen illum audistis, et in ipso edocti estis, sicut est veritas in Jesu,
text_pt: Se é que o tendes ouvido, e nele fostes ensinados, como está a verdade em Jesus;
text_el: εἴ γε αὐτὸν ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐδιδάχθητε, καθώς ἐστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: To put off, according to former conversation, the old man , who is corrupted according to the desire of error .
text_la: deponere vos secundum pristinam conversationem veterem hominem, qui corrumpitur secundum desideria erroris.
text_pt: Que, quanto ao trato passado, vos despojeis do velho homem, que se corrompe pelas concupiscências do engano;
text_el: ἀποθέσθαι ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὴν προτέραν ἀναστροφὴν τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν φθειρόμενον κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ἀπάτης,

text_en: And be renewed in spirit of your mind :
text_la: Renovamini autem spiritu mentis vestræ,
text_pt: E vos renoveis no espírito da vossa mente;
text_el: ἀνανεοῦσθαι δὲ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ νοὸς ὑμῶν,

text_en: And put on the new man , who according to God is created in justice and holiness of truth .
text_la: et induite novum hominem, qui secundum Deum creatus est in justitia, et sanctitate veritatis.
text_pt: E vos revistais do novo homem, que segundo Deus é criado em verdadeira justiça e santidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐνδύσασθαι τὸν καινὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν κατὰ θεὸν κτισθέντα ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ὁσιότητι τῆς ἀληθείας.

text_en: Wherefore, putting away lying , speak the truth , every man with his neighbour. For we are members one of another .
text_la: Propter quod deponentes mendacium, loquimini veritatem unusquisque cum proximo suo : quoniam sumus invicem membra.
text_pt: Por isso deixai a mentira, e falai a verdade cada um com o seu próximo; porque somos membros uns dos outros.
text_el: Διὸ ἀποθέμενοι τὸ ψεῦδος λαλεῖτε ἀλήθειαν ἕκαστος μετὰ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσμὲν ἀλλήλων μέλη.

text_en: Be angry : and sin not. Let not the sun go down upon your anger .
text_la: Irascimini, et nolite peccare : sol non occidat super iracundiam vestram.
text_pt: Irai-vos, e não pequeis; não se ponha o sol sobre a vossa ira.
text_el: ὀργίζεσθε καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε: ὁ ἥλιος μὴ ἐπιδυέτω ἐπὶ παροργισμῷ ὑμῶν,

text_en: Give not place to the devil .
text_la: Nolite locum dare diabolo:
text_pt: Não deis lugar ao diabo.
text_el: μηδὲ δίδοτε τόπον τῷ διαβόλῳ.

text_en: He that stole , let him now steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good , that he may have something to give to him that suffers need .
text_la: qui furabatur, jam non furetur : magis autem laboret, operando manibus suis, quod bonum est, ut habeat unde tribuat necessitatem patienti.
text_pt: Aquele que furtava, não furte mais; antes trabalhe, fazendo com as mãos o que é bom, para que tenha o que repartir com o que tiver necessidade.
text_el: ὁ κλέπτων μηκέτι κλεπτέτω, μᾶλλον δὲ κοπιάτω ἐργαζόμενος ταῖς χερσὶν τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἵνα ἔχῃ μεταδιδόναι τῷ χρείαν ἔχοντι.

text_en: Let no evil speech proceed from your mouth: but that which is good , to the edification of faith : that it may administer grace to the hearers.
text_la: Omnis sermo malus ex ore vestro non procedat: sed si quis bonus ad ædificationem fidei ut det gratiam audientibus.
text_pt: Não saia da vossa boca nenhuma palavra torpe, mas só a que for boa para promover a edificação, para que dê graça aos que a ouvem.
text_el: πᾶς λόγος σαπρὸς ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν μὴ ἐκπορευέσθω, ἀλλὰ εἴ τις ἀγαθὸς πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χρείας, ἵνα δῷ χάριν τοῖς ἀκούουσιν.

text_en: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God : whereby you are sealed unto the day of redemption .
text_la: Et nolite contristare Spiritum Sanctum Dei : in quo signati estis in diem redemptionis.
text_pt: E não entristeçais o Espírito Santo de Deus, no qual estais selados para o dia da redenção.
text_el: καὶ μὴ λυπεῖτε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐν ᾧ ἐσφραγίσθητε εἰς ἡμέραν ἀπολυτρώσεως.

text_en: Let all bitterness and anger and indignation and clamour and blasphemy be put away from you, with all malice .
text_la: Omnis amaritudo, et ira, et indignatio, et clamor, et blasphemia tollatur a vobis cum omni malitia.
text_pt: Toda a amargura, e ira, e cólera, e gritaria, e blasfêmia e toda a malícia sejam tiradas dentre vós,
text_el: πᾶσα πικρία καὶ θυμὸς καὶ ὀργὴ καὶ κραυγὴ καὶ βλασφημία ἀρθήτω ἀφ' ὑμῶν σὺν πάσῃ κακίᾳ.

text_en: And be kind one to another: merciful, forgiving one another, even as God has forgiven you in Christ .
text_la: Estote autem invicem benigni, misericordes, donantes invicem sicut et Deus in Christo donavit vobis.
text_pt: Antes sede uns para com os outros benignos, misericordiosos, perdoando-vos uns aos outros, como também Deus vos perdoou em Cristo.
text_el: γίνεσθε δὲ εἰς ἀλλήλους χρηστοί, εὔσπλαγχνοι, χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς καθὼς καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν Χριστῷ ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν.

text_en: Be therefore followers of God , as most dear children:
text_la: Estote ergo imitatores Dei, sicut filii carissimi,
text_pt: Sede, pois, imitadores de Deus, como filhos amados;
text_el: Γίνεσθε οὖν μιμηταὶ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὡς τέκνα ἀγαπητά,

text_en: And walk in love , as Christ also has loved us and has delivered himself for us, an oblation and a sacrifice to God for an odour of sweetness.
text_la: et ambulate in dilectione, sicut et Christus dilexit nos, et tradidit semetipsum pro nobis, oblationem et hostiam Deo in odorem suavitatis.
text_pt: E andai em amor, como também Cristo vos amou, e se entregou a si mesmo por nós, em oferta e sacrifício a Deus, em cheiro suave.
text_el: καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ὑμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν προσφορὰν καὶ θυσίαν τῷ θεῷ εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας.

text_en: But fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness , let it not so much as be named among you, as becomes saints :
text_la: Fornicatio autem, et omnis immunditia, aut avaritia, nec nominetur in vobis, sicut decet sanctos:
text_pt: Mas a fornicação, e toda a impureza ou avareza, nem ainda se nomeie entre vós, como convém a santos;
text_el: Πορνεία δὲ καὶ ἀκαθαρσία πᾶσα ἢ πλεονεξία μηδὲ ὀνομαζέσθω ἐν ὑμῖν, καθὼς πρέπει ἁγίοις,

text_en: Or obscenity or foolish talking or scurrility, which is to no purpose: but rather giving of thanks.
text_la: aut turpitudo, aut stultiloquium, aut scurrilitas, quæ ad rem non pertinet : sed magis gratiarum actio.
text_pt: Nem torpezas, nem parvoíces, nem chocarrices, que não convêm; mas antes, ações de graças.
text_el: καὶ αἰσχρότης καὶ μωρολογία ἢ εὐτραπελία, ἃ οὐκ ἀνῆκεν, ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εὐχαριστία.

text_en: For know you this and understand: That no fornicator or unclean or covetous person (which is a serving of idols ) has inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God .
text_la: Hoc enim scitote intelligentes : quod omnis fornicator, aut immundus, aut avarus, quod est idolorum servitus, non habet hæreditatem in regno Christi et Dei.
text_pt: Porque bem sabeis isto: que nenhum devasso, ou impuro, ou avarento, o qual é idólatra, tem herança no reino de Cristo e de Deus.
text_el: τοῦτο γὰρ ἴστε γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶς πόρνος ἢ ἀκάθαρτος ἢ πλεονέκτης, ὅ ἐστιν εἰδωλολάτρης, οὐκ ἔχει κληρονομίαν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θεοῦ.

text_en: Let no man deceive you with vain words. For because of these things comes the anger of God upon the children of unbelief.
text_la: Nemo vos seducat inanibus verbis : propter hæc enim venit ira Dei in filios diffidentiæ.
text_pt: Ninguém vos engane com palavras vãs; porque por estas coisas vem a ira de Deus sobre os filhos da desobediência.
text_el: μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς ἀπατάτω κενοῖς λόγοις, διὰ ταῦτα γὰρ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας.

text_en: Be not therefore partakers with them.
text_la: Nolite ergo effici participes eorum.
text_pt: Portanto, não sejais seus companheiros.
text_el: μὴ οὖν γίνεσθε συμμέτοχοι αὐτῶν:

text_en: For you were heretofore darkness, but now light in the Lord . Walk then as children of the light.
text_la: Eratis enim aliquando tenebræ : nunc autem lux in Domino. Ut filii lucis ambulate:
text_pt: Porque noutro tempo éreis trevas, mas agora sois luz no Senhor; andai como filhos da luz
text_el: ἦτε γάρ ποτε σκότος, νῦν δὲ φῶς ἐν κυρίῳ: ὡς τέκνα φωτὸς περιπατεῖτε

text_en: For the fruit of the light is in all goodness and justice and truth :
text_la: fructus enim lucis est in omni bonitate, et justitia, et veritate:
text_pt: (Porque o fruto do Espírito está em toda a bondade, e justiça e verdade);
text_el: ὁ γὰρ καρπὸς τοῦ φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ

text_en: Proving what is well pleasing to God .
text_la: probantes quid sit beneplacitum Deo:
text_pt: Aprovando o que é agradável ao Senhor.
text_el: δοκιμάζοντες τί ἐστιν εὐάρεστον τῷ κυρίῳ:

text_en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness : but rather reprove them.
text_la: et nolite communicare operibus infructuosis tenebrarum, magis autem redarguite.
text_pt: E não comuniqueis com as obras infrutuosas das trevas, mas antes condenai-as.
text_el: καὶ μὴ συγκοινωνεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἀκάρποις τοῦ σκότους, μᾶλλον δὲ καὶ ἐλέγχετε,

text_en: For the things that are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.
text_la: Quæ enim in occulto fiunt ab ipsis, turpe est et dicere.
text_pt: Porque o que eles fazem em oculto até dizê-lo é torpe.
text_el: τὰ γὰρ κρυφῇ γινόμενα ὑπ' αὐτῶν αἰσχρόν ἐστιν καὶ λέγειν:

text_en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for all that is made manifest is light.
text_la: Omnia autem, quæ arguuntur, a lumine manifestantur : omne enim, quod manifestatur, lumen est.
text_pt: Mas todas estas coisas se manifestam, sendo condenadas pela luz, porque a luz tudo manifesta.
text_el: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐλεγχόμενα ὑπὸ τοῦ φωτὸς φανεροῦται,

text_en: Wherefore he says: Rise, you that sleep, and arise from the dead: and Christ shall enlighten you.
text_la: Propter quod dicit : Surge qui dormis, et exsurge a mortuis, et illuminabit te Christus.
text_pt: Por isso diz: Desperta, tu que dormes, e levanta-te dentre os mortos, e Cristo te esclarecerá.
text_el: πᾶν γὰρ τὸ φανερούμενον φῶς ἐστιν. διὸ λέγει, ἔγειρε, ὁ καθεύδων, καὶ ἀνάστα ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἐπιφαύσει σοι ὁ Χριστός.

text_en: See therefore, brethren, how you walk circumspectly: not as unwise,
text_la: Videte itaque, fratres, quomodo caute ambuletis : non quasi insipientes,
text_pt: Portanto, vede prudentemente como andais, não como néscios, mas como sábios,
text_el: Βλέπετε οὖν ἀκριβῶς πῶς περιπατεῖτε, μὴ ὡς ἄσοφοι ἀλλ' ὡς σοφοί,

text_en: but as wise: redeeming the time , because the days are evil .
text_la: sed ut sapientes : redimentes tempus, quoniam dies mali sunt.
text_pt: Remindo o tempo; porquanto os dias são maus.
text_el: ἐξαγοραζόμενοι τὸν καιρόν, ὅτι αἱ ἡμέραι πονηραί εἰσιν.

text_en: Wherefore, become not unwise: but understanding what is the will of God .
text_la: Propterea nolite fieri imprudentes, sed intelligentes quæ sit voluntas Dei.
text_pt: Por isso não sejais insensatos, mas entendei qual seja a vontade do Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο μὴ γίνεσθε ἄφρονες, ἀλλὰ συνίετε τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ κυρίου.

text_en: And be not drunk with wine , wherein is luxury: but be filled with the Holy Spirit ,
text_la: Et nolite inebriari vino, in quo est luxuria, sed implemini Spiritu Sancto,
text_pt: E não vos embriagueis com vinho, em que há contenda, mas enchei-vos do Espírito;
text_el: καὶ μὴ μεθύσκεσθε οἴνῳ, ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἀσωτία, ἀλλὰ πληροῦσθε ἐν πνεύματι,

text_en: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual canticles , singing and making melody in your hearts to the Lord:
text_la: loquentes vobismetipsis in psalmis, et hymnis, et canticis spiritualibus, cantantes et psallentes in cordibus vestris Domino,
text_pt: Falando entre vós em salmos, e hinos, e cânticos espirituais; cantando e salmodiando ao Senhor no vosso coração;
text_el: λαλοῦντες ἑαυτοῖς ψαλμοῖς καὶ ὕμνοις καὶ ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς, ᾄδοντες καὶ ψάλλοντες τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν τῷ κυρίῳ,

text_en: Giving thanks always for all things, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , to God and the Father :
text_la: gratias agentes semper pro omnibus in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi Deo et Patri,
text_pt: Dando sempre graças por tudo a nosso Deus e Pai, em nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;
text_el: εὐχαριστοῦντες πάντοτε ὑπὲρ πάντων ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρί,

text_en: Being subject one to another, in the fear of Christ .
text_la: subjecti invicem in timore Christi.
text_pt: Sujeitando-vos uns aos outros no temor de Deus.
text_el: ὑποτασσόμενοι ἀλλήλοις ἐν φόβῳ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: Let women be subject to their husbands, as to the Lord :
text_la: Mulieres viris suis subditæ sint, sicut Domino:
text_pt: Vós, mulheres, sujeitai-vos a vossos maridos, como ao Senhor;
text_el: αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ,

text_en: Because the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the church . He is the saviour of his body.
text_la: quoniam vir caput est mulieris, sicut Christus caput est Ecclesiæ : ipse, salvator corporis ejus.
text_pt: Porque o marido é a cabeça da mulher, como também Cristo é a cabeça da igreja, sendo ele próprio o salvador do corpo.
text_el: ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν κεφαλὴ τῆς γυναικὸς ὡς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς κεφαλὴ τῆς ἐκκλησίας, αὐτὸς σωτὴρ τοῦ σώματος.

text_en: Therefore as the church is subject to Christ : so also let the wives be to their husbands in all things.
text_la: Sed sicut Ecclesia subjecta est Christo, ita et mulieres viris suis in omnibus.
text_pt: De sorte que, assim como a igreja está sujeita a Cristo, assim também as mulheres sejam em tudo sujeitas a seus maridos.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὡς ἡ ἐκκλησία ὑποτάσσεται τῷ Χριστῷ, οὕτως καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐν παντί.

text_en: Husbands, love your wives, as Christ also loved the church and delivered himself up for it:
text_la: Viri, diligite uxores vestras, sicut et Christus dilexit Ecclesiam, et seipsum tradidit pro ea,
text_pt: Vós, maridos, amai vossas mulheres, como também Cristo amou a igreja, e a si mesmo se entregou por ela,
text_el: Οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἑαυτὸν παρέδωκεν ὑπὲρ αὐτῆς,

text_en: That he might sanctify it, cleansing it by the laver of water in the word of life:
text_la: ut illam sanctificaret, mundans lavacro aquæ in verbo vitæ,
text_pt: Para a santificar, purificando-a com a lavagem da água, pela palavra,
text_el: ἵνα αὐτὴν ἁγιάσῃ καθαρίσας τῷ λουτρῷ τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν ῥήματι,

text_en: That he might present it to himself, a glorious church , not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
text_la: ut exhiberet ipse sibi gloriosam Ecclesiam, non habentem maculam, aut rugam, aut aliquid hujusmodi, sed ut sit sancta et immaculata.
text_pt: Para a apresentar a si mesmo igreja gloriosa, sem mácula, nem ruga, nem coisa semelhante, mas santa e irrepreensível.
text_el: ἵνα παραστήσῃ αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ ἔνδοξον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, μὴ ἔχουσαν σπίλον ἢ ῥυτίδα ἤ τι τῶν τοιούτων, ἀλλ' ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ ἄμωμος.

text_en: So also ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loves his wife loves himself.
text_la: Ita et viri debent diligere uxores suas ut corpora sua. Qui suam uxorem diligit, seipsum diligit.
text_pt: Assim devem os maridos amar as suas próprias mulheres, como a seus próprios corpos. Quem ama a sua mulher, ama-se a si mesmo.
text_el: οὕτως ὀφείλουσιν [καὶ] οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶν τὰς ἑαυτῶν γυναῖκας ὡς τὰ ἑαυτῶν σώματα. ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἑαυτὸν ἀγαπᾷ,

text_en: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, as also Christ does the church :
text_la: Nemo enim umquam carnem suam odio habuit : sed nutrit et fovet eam, sicut et Christus Ecclesiam:
text_pt: Porque nunca ninguém odiou a sua própria carne; antes a alimenta e sustenta, como também o Senhor à igreja;
text_el: οὐδεὶς γάρ ποτε τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σάρκα ἐμίσησεν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφει καὶ θάλπει αὐτήν, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν,

text_en: Because we are members of him, body, of his flesh and of his bones.
text_la: quia membra sumus corporis ejus, de carne ejus et de ossibus ejus.
text_pt: Porque somos membros do seu corpo, da sua carne, e dos seus ossos.
text_el: ὅτι μέλη ἐσμὲν τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ.

text_en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother: and shall cleave to his wife. And they shall be two in one flesh.
text_la: Propter hoc relinquet homo patrem et matrem suam, et adhærebit uxori suæ, et erunt duo in carne una.
text_pt: Por isso deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe, e se unirá a sua mulher; e serão dois numa carne.
text_el: ἀντὶ τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος [τὸν] πατέρα καὶ [τὴν] μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα, αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.

text_en: This is a great sacrament : but I speak in Christ and in the church .
text_la: Sacramentum hoc magnum est, ego autem dico in Christo et in Ecclesia.
text_pt: Grande é este mistério; digo-o, porém, a respeito de Cristo e da igreja.
text_el: τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο μέγα ἐστίν, ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ [εἰς] τὴν ἐκκλησίαν.

text_en: Nevertheless, let every one of you in particular love for his wife as himself: And let the wife fear her husband.
text_la: Verumtamen et vos singuli, unusquisque uxorem suam sicut seipsum diligat : uxor autem timeat virum suum.
text_pt: Assim também vós, cada um em particular, ame a sua própria mulher como a si mesmo, e a mulher reverencie o marido.
text_el: πλὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς οἱ καθ' ἕνα ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα οὕτως ἀγαπάτω ὡς ἑαυτόν, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἵνα φοβῆται τὸν ἄνδρα.

text_en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord : for this is just .
text_la: Filii, obedite parentibus vestris in Domino : hoc enim justum est.
text_pt: Vós, filhos, sede obedientes a vossos pais no Senhor, porque isto é justo.
text_el: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν δίκαιον.

text_en: Honour your father and your mother , which is the first commandment with a promise :
text_la: Honora patrem tuum, et matrem tuam, quod est mandatum primum in promissione:
text_pt: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, que é o primeiro mandamento com promessa;
text_el: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ,

text_en: That it may be well with you, and you may be long lived upon earth.
text_la: ut bene sit tibi, et sis longævus super terram.
text_pt: Para que te vá bem, e vivas muito tempo sobre a terra.
text_el: ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And you, fathers, provoke not your children to anger : but bring them up in the discipline and correction of the Lord .
text_la: Et vos patres, nolite ad iracundiam provocare filios vestros : sed educate illos in disciplina et correptione Domini.
text_pt: E vós, pais, não provoqueis à ira a vossos filhos, mas criai-os na doutrina e admoestação do Senhor.
text_el: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες, μὴ παροργίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ κυρίου.

text_en: Servants, be obedient to them that are your lords according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in the simplicity of your heart, as to Christ .
text_la: Servi, obedite dominis carnalibus cum timore et tremore, in simplicitate cordis vestri, sicut Christo:
text_pt: Vós, servos, obedecei a vossos senhores segundo a carne, com temor e tremor, na sinceridade de vosso coração, como a Cristo;
text_el: Οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ,

text_en: Not serving to the eye, as it were pleasing men : but, as the servants of Christ , doing the will of God from the heart.
text_la: non ad oculum servientes, quasi hominibus placentes, sed ut servi Christi, facientes voluntatem Dei ex animo,
text_pt: Não servindo à vista, como para agradar aos homens, mas como servos de Cristo, fazendo de coração a vontade de Deus;
text_el: μὴ κατ' ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἀλλ' ὡς δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκ ψυχῆς,

text_en: With a good will serving, as to the Lord , and not to men .
text_la: cum bona voluntate servientes, sicut Domino, et non hominibus:
text_pt: Servindo de boa vontade como ao Senhor, e não como aos homens.
text_el: μετ' εὐνοίας δουλεύοντες, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,

text_en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man shall do, the same shall he receive from the Lord , whether he be bond or free.
text_la: scientes quoniam unusquisque quodcumque fecerit bonum, hoc recipiet a Domino, sive servus, sive liber.
text_pt: Sabendo que cada um receberá do Senhor todo o bem que fizer, seja servo, seja livre.
text_el: εἰδότες ὅτι ἕκαστος, ἐάν τι ποιήσῃ ἀγαθόν, τοῦτο κομίσεται παρὰ κυρίου, εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος.

text_en: And you, masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatenings: knowing that the Lord both of them and you is in heaven . And there is no respect of persons with him.
text_la: Et vos domini, eadem facite illis, remittentes minas : scientes quia et illorum et vester Dominus est in cælis : et personarum acceptio non est apud eum.
text_pt: E vós, senhores, fazei o mesmo para com eles, deixando as ameaças, sabendo também que o Senhor deles e vosso está no céu, e que para com ele não há acepção de pessoas.
text_el: καὶ οἱ κύριοι, τὰ αὐτὰ ποιεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς, ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν ὁ κύριός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ προσωπολημψία οὐκ ἔστιν παρ' αὐτῷ.

text_en: Finally, brethren, be strengthened in the Lord and in the might of his power.
text_la: De cetero, fratres, confortamini in Domino, et in potentia virtutis ejus.
text_pt: No demais, irmãos meus, fortalecei-vos no Senhor e na força do seu poder.
text_el: τοῦ λοιποῦ ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Put you on the armour of God , that you may be able to stand against the deceits of the devil .
text_la: Induite vos armaturam Dei, ut possitis stare adversus insidias diaboli:
text_pt: Revesti-vos de toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais estar firmes contra as astutas ciladas do diabo.
text_el: ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς τὸ δύνασθαι ὑμᾶς στῆναι πρὸς τὰς μεθοδείας τοῦ διαβόλου:

text_en: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood ; but against principalities and powers , against the rulers of the world of this darkness, against the spirits of wickedness in the high places.
text_la: quoniam non est nobis colluctatio adversus carnem et sanguinem, sed adversus principes, et potestates, adversus mundi rectores tenebrarum harum, contra spiritualia nequitiæ, in cælestibus.
text_pt: Porque não temos que lutar contra a carne e o sangue, mas, sim, contra os principados, contra as potestades, contra os príncipes das trevas deste século, contra as hostes espirituais da maldade, nos lugares celestiais.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη πρὸς αἷμα καὶ σάρκα, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς, πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας, πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ σκότους τούτου, πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις.

text_en: Therefore, take unto you the armour of God , that you may be able to resist in the evil day and to stand in all things perfect .
text_la: Propterea accipite armaturam Dei, ut possitis resistere in die malo, et in omnibus perfecti stare.
text_pt: Portanto, tomai toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais resistir no dia mau e, havendo feito tudo, ficar firmes.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ καὶ ἅπαντα κατεργασάμενοι στῆναι.

text_en: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth and having on the breastplate of justice :
text_la: State ergo succincti lumbos vestros in veritate, et induti loricam justitiæ,
text_pt: Estai, pois, firmes, tendo cingidos os vossos lombos com a verdade, e vestida a couraça da justiça;
text_el: στῆτε οὖν περιζωσάμενοι τὴν ὀσφὺν ὑμῶν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης,

text_en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace.
text_la: et calceati pedes in præparatione Evangelii pacis,
text_pt: E calçados os pés na preparação do evangelho da paz;
text_el: καὶ ὑποδησάμενοι τοὺς πόδας ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης,

text_en: In all things taking the shield of faith , wherewith you may be able to extinguish all the fiery darts of the most wicked one .
text_la: in omnibus sumentes scutum fidei, in quo possitis omnia tela nequissimi ignea extinguere:
text_pt: Tomando sobretudo o escudo da fé, com o qual podereis apagar todos os dardos inflamados do maligno.
text_el: ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως, ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε πάντα τὰ βέλη τοῦ πονηροῦ τὰ πεπυρωμένα σβέσαι:

text_en: And take unto you the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit (which is the word of God ).
text_la: et galeam salutis assumite, et gladium spiritus (quod est verbum Dei),
text_pt: Tomai também o capacete da salvação, e a espada do Espírito, que é a palavra de Deus;
text_el: καὶ τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου δέξασθε, καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ πνεύματος, ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα θεοῦ,

text_en: By all prayer and supplication praying at all times in the spirit : and in the same watching with all instance and supplication for all the saints :
text_la: per omnem orationem et obsecrationem orantes omni tempore in spiritu : et in ipso vigilantes in omni instantia et obsecratione pro omnibus sanctis:
text_pt: Orando em todo o tempo com toda a oração e súplica no Espírito, e vigiando nisto com toda a perseverança e súplica por todos os santos,
text_el: διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως προσευχόμενοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἐν πνεύματι, καὶ εἰς αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων,

text_en: And for me, that speech may be given me, that I may open my mouth with confidence, to make known the mystery of the gospel ,
text_la: et pro me, ut detur mihi sermo in apertione oris mei cum fiducia, notum facere mysterium Evangelii:
text_pt: E por mim; para que me seja dada, no abrir da minha boca, a palavra com confiança, para fazer notório o mistério do evangelho,
text_el: καὶ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα μοι δοθῇ λόγος ἐν ἀνοίξει τοῦ στόματός μου, ἐν παρρησίᾳ γνωρίσαι τὸ μυστήριον [τοῦ εὐαγγελίου]

text_en: for which I am an ambassador in a chain: so that therein I may be bold to speak according as I ought.
text_la: pro quo legatione fungor in catena, ita ut in ipso audeam, prout oportet me loqui.
text_pt: Pelo qual sou embaixador em cadeias; para que possa falar dele livremente, como me convém falar.
text_el: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ παρρησιάσωμαι ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.

text_en: But that you also may know the things that concern me and what I am doing, Tychicus , my dearest brother and faithful minister in the Lord , will make known to you all things:
text_la: Ut autem et vos sciatis quæ circa me sunt, quid agam, omnia vobis nota faciet Tychicus, carissimus frater, et fidelis minister in Domino:
text_pt: Ora, para que vós também possais saber dos meus negócios, e o que eu faço, Tíquico, irmão amado, e fiel ministro do Senhor, vos informará de tudo.
text_el: Ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ κατ' ἐμέ, τί πράσσω, πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος ἐν κυρίῳ,

text_en: Whom I have sent to you for this same purpose: that you may know the things concerning us, and that he may comfort your hearts.
text_la: quem misi ad vos in hoc ipsum, ut cognoscatis quæ circa nos sunt, et consoletur corda vestra.
text_pt: O qual vos enviei para o mesmo fim, para que saibais do nosso estado, e ele console os vossos corações.
text_el: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.

text_en: Peace be to the brethren and charity with faith , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
text_la: Pax fratribus, et caritas cum fide a Deo Patre et Domino Jesu Christo.
text_pt: Paz seja com os irmãos, e amor com fé da parte de Deus Pai e da do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
text_el: Εἰρήνη τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καὶ ἀγάπη μετὰ πίστεως ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in incorruption. Amen .
text_la: Gratia cum omnibus qui diligunt Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum in incorruptione. Amen.
text_pt: A graça seja com todos os que amam a nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo em sinceridade. Amém.
text_el: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ.
